fields.summary_ko.0: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing (TSM) has declined approximately 26% from its October peak of $487, with an undervaluation at 15.38x net profit estimates and attractive next-year growth prospects.
fields.summary_ko.1: TSMC's October 2026 revenue increased 59.7% year-over-year, and risk diversification through AI customer diversification (NVIDIA, AMD, Google, Amazon, etc.) provides resilience amid industry-wide downturn.
